technical.summary: Short-term momentum is bullish with overbought RSI and stoch cross-up, but conflicting MACD bearish signal, price below 200-MA, and lack of intermediate trend confirmation limit swing entry probability.

fundamental.summary: MMM shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and elevated earnings risk in 88 days—fundamentals lack bullish catalysts.

sentiment.summary: Mixed signals: Congressional activity is minimal and dated (165+ days); market fear (42/100) presents contrarian opportunity, but lack of recent news data and neutral AAII sentiment prevent conviction.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds with VIX in crisis territory (335), flat yield curve signalling recession risk, and recent FOMC event creating elevated volatility; earnings 88 days out provides minimal near-term binary risk but macro environment is highly unfavourable for equities.

debate.key_bull_argument: Short-term momentum is bullish (RSI overbought, stoch cross-up, supertrend bullish, Ichimoku above cloud) with price near support (101.189) offering defined risk entry for swing traders.
debate.key_bear_argument: Fundamental weakness (no insider conviction, earnings risk in 88 days), macro crisis (VIX 335, recession yield curve), MACD bearish divergence, price below 200-MA/50-SMA, and extreme RSI overbought (77.65) create pullback risk that outweighs short-term momentum.

decision.entry_rationale: Short-term momentum (RSI overbought, stoch cross, supertrend bullish) offers tactical appeal at support, but macro crisis (VIX 335, recession yield curve) and fundamental weakness (no insider conviction, MACD bearish divergence) create asymmetric downside risk that outweighs swing entry probability.
decision.primary_risk: VIX crisis environment combined with extreme RSI overbought (77.65) and MACD bearish divergence creates high probability of sharp pullback below support (101.189) before any swing target is reached.
